title: Microsoft working on Defender patch for ShieldBreak zero-day
summary: Since April, Nightmare Eclipse has disclosed multiple zero-day exploits targeting Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, and various other Windows components, now known as LegacyHive , RoguePlanet , BlueHammer , RedSun , YellowKey , GreenPlasma , MiniPlasma , and UnDefend .
